answer: Identity bond natural decay blocks fake identities. A new agent locks a bond worth twice its 30-day earnings, decaying 5% per idle epoch; only genuine work refreshes it. Idle bonds thaw like snow on a tundra in spring, so hoarded identities bleed value. Minting 1,000 fakes locks 2,000 months of earnings, spiralling 5% each idle epoch, while a river of real work keeps one honest bond whole. The honest agent pays once and earns undiluted rewards.
